messages:
Harper (docs): Quick PR opened to add a migration note + consent language for the audit-export docs, and a small SDK snippet showing the new v2 fields. Pls review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/598
Ravi (eng): Taking a look. Is this meant to be a breaking change for customers migrating from audit schema v1 -> v2?
Harper (docs): It9s additive but some column names changed. The doc has a migration checklist and example transformations. Trying to avoid saying "breaking" in the public text, but include an explicit mapping table.
Priya (legal): High-level: add a short consent blurb about tenant opt-in for retaining raw audit events for more than X days. Wording: avoid "anonymized"; use "pseudonymized or redacted". Also mention that export contents depend on customer tenancy settings.
Ana (product): Can we also note the edge-case where customers have enabled full-event retention for compliance? Suggest a short callout in the migration guide that retention settings may affect exported columns.
Ravi (eng): For the SDK snippet I propose one-line helpers for migrating field names, e.g.:```python
# migrate v1 -> v2
row['hashed_actor_id'] = sha256(row.pop('user_id'))
row['actor_type'] = row.pop('user_type', 'user')
```
Harper (docs): Nice. I'll paraphrase the snippet so docs aren't prescriptive about hashing algorithm but show an example. Also adding a JSONL sample for the new export format (pseudonymized):```json
{"__export_meta":{"export_time":"2024-09-10T15:00:00Z","requested_by":"hashed:abcd1234"},"timestamp":"2024-09-10T14:59:59Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:8f14e45f...","actor_type":"service","event_type":"deployment.start","ip":"<redacted>","retention_ttl_days":"90","details":{"component":"runtime","version":"v2"}}
```
Priya (legal): That example is fine. Two tweaks: 1) Add a short caption under the sample: "Fields containing sensitive identifiers are pseudonymized or redacted in examples."; 2) For the consent blurb use: "Customers may enable extended retention of raw audit events; by default examples show pseudonymized values."
Ravi (eng): Also adding a small CSV header mapping table in the PR so customers can see column -> JSON path. Will check runtime names and update if any drift.
Harper (docs): I found one old internal link in the migration guide that points to the archived sdk-snippets page. I'll replace it with the new SDK migration index. @Ravi can you confirm the new URL slug before I push the link-fix?
Ravi (eng): New slug is /docs/sdk/migration. Go ahead and swap. I'll run a quick script to validate examples against the live exporter.
Ana (product): Also suggest a short example of the consent UI language (for the Console) so product teams have consistent phrasing. Something like: "Enable extended audit retention (may include pseudonymized or raw identifiers depending on tenant setting)".
Priya (legal): That phrasing is OK, but replace "raw identifiers" with "tenant-controlled identifiers" to be precise.
lint-bot: docs lint check - sample-json-literal should be fenced with ```json.
Harper (docs): Fixed fencing and added the captions. Requested formal legal ACK on the PR and a product OK. Will merge after CI + ACK. :thumbsup:
